privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: BATTECHNO LMS (operated by BATTECHNO) processes account and academic data to deliver learning, field training, assessment, and institutional reporting services.
privacy.collectBody: Account identity (name, email, phone when provided), university affiliation, role, learning progress, field-training applications and submissions, grades, attendance, certificates, notifications, and technical logs needed to operate and secure the service.
privacy.useBody: We use data to authenticate users, deliver courses and training workflows, issue certificates, support institutional quality processes, provide customer support, and meet legal or audit obligations.
privacy.retentionBody: Academic, attendance, grading, certificate, and audit records may be retained for institutional, legal, or security obligations even after an account deletion request is completed. Personal identity fields may be anonymized when a deletion request is approved and processed.
privacy.deletionBody: You may request deletion of your BATTECHNO LMS account from the app (Settings → Account Management → Request Account Deletion) or through the form on the account deletion page. We will verify account ownership before processing the request.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy or account-deletion questions: privacy@battechno.com

deletion.title: BATTECHNO LMS account deletion request
deletion.subtitle: BATTECHNO LMS · BATTECHNO
deletion.intro: To request deletion of your account and associated data, use “Request Account Deletion” in the app settings, or submit a request through the form on this page.
deletion.verifyBody: We will verify account ownership before processing the request.
deletion.scopeTitle: What is deleted and what may be retained
deletion.scopeBody: Deletion covers account data, profile data, and data related to platform use, except data that must be retained temporarily for legal or security obligations or to prevent fraud.
deletion.step1: Sign in to the BATTECHNO LMS mobile app with the account you want deleted.
deletion.step2: Open Profile → Settings → Account Management → Delete Account / Request Account Deletion.
deletion.step3: Read the explanation, confirm with your password, type DELETE, and submit the request.
deletion.step4: The request is reviewed after ownership verification. You may cancel while it is still pending.
deletion.formIntro: Use this form to open an account-deletion request ticket. Your account will not be deleted immediately, and a request will never be completed from an email address alone without verification.
deletion.formMessagePlaceholder: I want to request deletion of my BATTECHNO LMS account…
deletion.formHint: This opens your email client to message privacy@battechno.com. Do not include your password.
deletion.inactiveBody: If your account is inactive or you cannot access the app, use the form below or email privacy@battechno.com from the address registered on the account. Do not send passwords.
deletion.deletedBody: After an approved request is completed, account data, profile data, and platform-use data are deleted or anonymized from the active profile, and login is disabled.
deletion.retainedBody: Some data may be retained temporarily for legal or security obligations or to prevent fraud, and academic or audit records may be retained when required by institutional or legal duties.
deletion.timingBody: Requests are reviewed after account ownership is verified. Submitting a request is not the same as immediate deletion.
